name: Daitenshi Michaela-sama no Haramase Shinpan ~Ii Deshou, Suki na Dake Dashinasai. Watashi wa Kairaku nado ni Makemasen!~
original_name: 大天使ミカエラ様の孕ませ審判～いいでしょう、好きなだけ出しなさい。私は快楽などに負けません！～
source:
Suddenly, the archangel Michaela visited the main character.
She has a very noble mind and came to the earth to judge the corrupted human beings.
But he thought that she came to him to become his girlfriend!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE062604.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
大天使Michaela突然来到主人公面前。
她拥有无比高洁的心灵，降临地球是为了审判堕落的人类。
然而，他却以为她是来做自己女朋友的！
